summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal interventions and policy updates affecting the Indian retail landscape, alongside noteworthy developments in the tech and satellite sectors.

bullets.text: Maharashtra court staff suspend strike following Bombay High Court's intervention on November 17, 2026.
Delhi has notified the 2026 Rules for online filing and tracking of citizen service applications, enhancing service delivery efficiency.
Milk prices in India are projected to rise by Rs 4-8 per litre in FY27 due to ongoing supply constraints, according to CareEdge Ratings.
Ambani's Reliance plans to build a 1,600-satellite network to compete with Starlink, aiming to enhance India's satellite internet capabilities.
Khan Market retains its position as the 24th most expensive retail street globally, with rents increasing by 14% this year.
